mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the removal of obsolete, damaged, or irrelevant materials from the library collection (Alemna & Mensah, 2023)."
Weeding refers to the removal of obsolete, damaged, or irrelevant materials from the library collection (Alemna & Mensah, 2023).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a combination of various content forms-text, audio, images, animations, and video-to communicate information (Stecuła, 2022)."
Multimedia refers to a combination of various content forms-text, audio, images, animations, and video-to communicate information (Stecuła, 2022).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of creating and maintaining descriptive and subject metadata (records) for each item in a library so users can find, identify, select and obtain materials efficiently."
Cataloguing is the process of creating and maintaining descriptive and subject metadata (records) for each item in a library so users can find, identify, select and obtain materials efficiently.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the language and layout suitable? 3."
Age/readability match - is the language and layout suitable? 3.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means creating substitute instructional or library materials from readily available local or recycled resources when standard materials are unavailable or unaffordable."
Improvisation means creating substitute instructional or library materials from readily available local or recycled resources when standard materials are unavailable or unaffordable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to learning facilitated through electronic technologies such as computers, tablets, and the internet (Stecuła, 2022)."
E-learning refers to learning facilitated through electronic technologies such as computers, tablets, and the internet (Stecuła, 2022).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a professionally trained educator and librarian who manages the school library while actively supporting teaching, learning, and literacy development."
A teacher-librarian is a professionally trained educator and librarian who manages the school library while actively supporting teaching, learning, and literacy development.
fib: ______ refers to the routine care and handling of library materials to keep them in usable condition.
Maintenance
Maintenance refers to the routine care and handling of library materials to keep them in usable condition.
______ is the systematic arrangement of books and materials according to subjects to allow easy retrieval.
Classification
Classification is the systematic arrangement of books and materials according to subjects to allow easy retrieval.
______ is an electronic device that accepts data (input), processes it using instructions (software), stores it, and produces output in a usable form.
computer system
A computer system is an electronic device that accepts data (input), processes it using instructions (software), stores it, and produces output in a usable form.
______ refers to the integration of computing, telecommunications, and digital tools used for information storage, retrieval, processing, communication, and dissemination.
Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
Information and Communication Technology
ICT

Information and Communication Technology (ICT) refers to the integration of computing, telecommunications, and digital tools used for information storage, retrieval, processing, communication, and dissemination.
______ refers to all activities involved in building and maintaining an effective collection of materials that support the educational goals of the school (Nwosu, 2023).
Library resource development
Library resource development refers to all activities involved in building and maintaining an effective collection of materials that support the educational goals of the school (Nwosu, 2023).

______ means creating substitute instructional and learning materials from readily available local or recycled materials when commercial or manufactured resources are unavailable, unaffordable, or unsuitable.
Improvisation of library/teaching resources

Improvisation of library/teaching resources means creating substitute instructional and learning materials from readily available local or recycled materials when commercial or manufactured resources are unavailable, unaffordable, or unsuitable.
______ is a physical and digital learning space within an elementary/primary or secondary school that serves the information and curriculum needs of students and teachers, managed by qualified staff.
school library

A school library is a physical and digital learning space within an elementary/primary or secondary school that serves the information and curriculum needs of students and teachers, managed by qualified staff.
